svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.53k stars in total, about 1.88k a year earlier. jactionlint 348, mr boxington 782, aube 2075, fnox 2412, hk 1347, pitchfork 719, usage 1080, +6 more 763.
